title: Cruise'n'Walk: river and sea cruises combined with guided hikes in Europe
notes: CroisiEurope's partner newsletter of 17 Nov 2026 presents 'walking cruises' for 2027: a cruise where each port day offers a guided walk or hike, then the traveller returns to the ship for the night.

Walks are led by qualified mountain guides and generally last two to five hours, with full-day hikes on some cruises. Walkers need not be experienced but good fitness is recommended. CroisiEurope says the routes were tested by a French walking club; times are indicative and exclude breaks.
Every walking cruise has a parallel programme for non-walkers (guided city tours, museums, tastings), so couples with different energy levels can share the same cruise.

Five itineraries are featured, all port-to-port 2027 sailings: Romantic Rhine Valley (Strasbourg, Koblenz, Rudesheim, Mannheim; 5 days; vineyard hike at Rudesheim, Neckar walk at Heidelberg); Douro Valley (Porto, Regua, Pinhao, Salamanca day, Barca d'Alva; 8 days; walks to Provesende, Vultures' Cliff, vineyards, Porto's coast); Danube (Vienna, Melk, Durnstein, Bratislava, Budapest, Esztergom; 8 days; Aggstein Castle ruins, Devinska Kobyla reserve, Visegrad Fortress, Leopoldsberg above Vienna); Rhone and Saone (Lyon, Macon, Vienne, Avignon, Arles, Camargue, Viviers, Tournon; 8 days; Roche de Solutre, Alpilles and Les Baux, Crussol Castle ruins); Corsica (Nice, Ajaccio, Bonifacio, Porto Vecchio, Bastia, L'Ile Rousse; 8 days; Calanques de Piana, Cap de Pertusatu, Col de Bavella, Murato, Bonifatu Forest).

Onboard, CroisiEurope says meals and drinks are included, with excursions, headsets, Wi-Fi and port fees included. This is the operator's own description, so attribute it and do not promise it as ours.

Do NOT state any price, discount, booking code or departure date: the newsletter's early-booking offer is a trade-partner offer with a code and a deadline. Send readers to the operator for current fares and dates.
Corsica is French territory and the Danube and Rhine routes cross Schengen countries, so Schengen visa rules apply for travellers who need a visa.
